{{Quote|Look on the bright side, Prudy. You still have that hospital I bought you.''"<br />"''The gangsters burned it to the ground.|Doc and Prudy|<ref name="Best" />}}
A '''refugee hospital''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Best" /> In [[3644 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] and adventurer [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]]&mdash;better known as Doc&mdash;bought the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] for his then-fiancée, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Prudy]]. However, Kimble broke off their engagement not long afterwards, and Prudy continued to run the hospital for the next [[3642 BBY|two]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Unidentified criminal gang|gang]] of criminals from whom Kimble had stolen the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] tracked down their money. The gang kidnapped Prudy and held her hostage in order to force Kimble to deliver the shipment of valuable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] he owed them, and the group burned the building to the ground after taking Prudy hostage.<ref name="Best" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prudy's hospital is first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the conversation "Best Intentions" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class's companion character Doc.<ref name="Best" />
